:::{#def-column-vector}
#### Column vector

A **column vector**
[@wikipedia_row_and_column_vectors]
of length $p$ is an ordered list of $p$ [real numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers),
written vertically as a $p \times 1$ array:

$$
\vx =
\begin{bmatrix}
x_{1} \\
x_{2} \\
\vdots \\
x_{p}
\end{bmatrix}
$$

:::
